description: This file contains Go source code defining structures, functions, and tools for managing GitHub issues via GraphQL and REST APIs, including issue creation, updating, listing, commenting, sub-issue management, and assigning Copilot.

methods.name: fetchIssueIDs
methods.description: Retrieves issue IDs via GraphQL API, fetching either only the main issue ID or both main and duplicate issue IDs based on the duplicateOf parameter.

methods.name: getCloseStateReason
methods.description: Converts a string state reason to the IssueClosedStateReason enum value.

methods.name: IssueRead
methods.description: Creates a tool to get details of a specific issue, comments, sub-issues, or labels in a GitHub repository.

methods.name: GetIssue
methods.description: Fetches a specific issue's details from GitHub, with optional lockdown mode filtering.

methods.name: GetIssueComments
methods.description: Fetches comments for a specific issue, with optional lockdown mode filtering.

methods.name: GetSubIssues
methods.description: Lists sub-issues of a specific issue, with optional lockdown mode filtering.

methods.name: GetIssueLabels
methods.description: Retrieves labels assigned to a specific issue via GraphQL.

methods.name: ListIssueTypes
methods.description: Creates a tool to list supported issue types for an organization.

methods.name: AddIssueComment
methods.description: Adds a comment to a specific issue.

methods.name: SubIssueWrite
methods.description: Creates a tool to add, remove, or reprioritize sub-issues within a parent issue.

methods.name: AddSubIssue
methods.description: Adds a sub-issue to a parent issue.

methods.name: RemoveSubIssue
methods.description: Removes a sub-issue from a parent issue.

methods.name: ReprioritizeSubIssue
methods.description: Changes the order of sub-issues within a parent issue.

methods.name: SearchIssues
methods.description: Creates a tool to search issues using GitHub search syntax with optional filters.

methods.name: IssueWrite
methods.description: Creates a tool to create or update issues in a GitHub repository.

methods.name: CreateIssue
methods.description: Creates a new issue with specified parameters.

methods.name: UpdateIssue
methods.description: Updates an existing issue, including changing state via GraphQL mutations.

methods.name: ListIssues
methods.description: Lists and filters issues in a repository with pagination and filtering options.

methods.name: AssignCopilotToIssue
methods.description: Assigns the GitHub Copilot bot to a specific issue.

methods.name: AssignCodingAgentPrompt
methods.description: Creates a prompt to guide assigning the coding agent to issues based on criteria.
